literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该模型在保留测试集上的博伊斯指数为 0.971,AUC 为 0.976。与基于点的 ENM 基线相比,它发现南亚、东南亚和南美洲的环境适宜区域增加了 6-18%。 [10.64898/2026.08.10.26359943]
CHIM 中 DENV-3 的基本繁殖数估计为 21.7,完全根除病毒所需的典型 C avg,ss 为 1,410 ng/mL。对各剂量组的 Mosnodenvir 暴露指标进行了估计,PopPK-VDM 组合方法证明了 抗病毒药物 对病毒粒子生产率的影响。 [10.1002/cpt.70439]
新生儿第五天出现发热和皮疹,NS1抗原检测呈阳性,确诊为诊断。还记录了 2 级脑室内出血。 [10.52226/tkk51m69]
NLR 值和 NS1 抗原水平之间观察到统计学上显着的弱正相关(r = 0.287;p = 0.026)。 [10.21070/ups.11494]
过去十年来,案件数量急剧增加。虽然所有三个模型都表现出相对较好的性能,但 BiLSTM 模型显着优于其他两个模型。 [10.4038/sljot.v7i1.20]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The model achieved a Boyce index of 0.971 and an AUC of 0.976 on the held-out test set. It identified 6–18% more environmentally suitable area across South Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America compared to point-based ENM baselines. [10.64898/2026.08.10.26359943]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Pinellas County increased mosquito control efforts in response to a Dengue Fever alert from the Department of Health-Pinellas. This is a confirmed event based on the official notice. [news-7d9fa789cbdbd04c]

A dengue outbreak was reported, with nine new laboratory-confirmed cases in EW32, bringing the cumulative total to 76 confirmed cases. The report is issued by ReliefWeb and the South Pacific Community (SPC). [news-3b214ad7872f161c]

Dengue outbreaks have been reported across multiple Pacific Island Countries and Areas (PICs) since 1 January 2025. The Pacific Syndromic Surveillance System (PSSS) has reported a total of 8 873 Dengue-like Illness (DLI) cases to date, with a lower trend compared to the same period last year. [news-93e5985bdfb81170]

Pinellas County confirmed two cases of dengue, the first locally acquired in over 15 years, according to the Florida Department of Health. The Pasco County Mosquito Control District confirmed a case of dengue fever in the West Pasco area. [news-5f63552c8fb5e9f0]

papers.title: The Comparative Effectiveness of Vector Control Approaches for Dengue: A Systematic Review and Multilevel Network Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Dengue vector control plays an important role in reducing the burden of dengue infection. Conventional meta‐analysis can only include interventions that can be directly compared. Hence, this study aimed to compare the effectiveness of all interventions for dengue vector control directly and indirectly through a multilevel Bayesian network meta‐analysis. Methods Cluster randomised controlled trials (cRCTs) and randomised controlled trials (RCTs) were included. Screening and full‐text review were performed independently by two reviewers, with resolution by a third reviewer if there was disagreement. Outcomes measured for the included studies considered were entomological indices and epidemiological measures. The Cochrane risk of bias tool was used to assess the quality of the studies by two independent reviewers, with a third reviewer to resolve any discrepancies. Results A total of 48 cRCTs and 13 RCTs were included in this study. The quality of cRCTs and RCTs was overall deemed at high risk of bias except for two studies with low risk of bias. The network meta‐analyses and narrative synthesis indicate that most interventions are not significantly superior to one another. Despite the lack of statistically significant results in the network meta‐analyses, a standalone intervention appears to be less effective than combined interventions. Conclusions Although most interventions were not found to be significantly superior to one another in the network meta‐analyses, it is noteworthy that standalone interventions were shown to be less effective than combined interventions. These results reinforce the importance of promoting integrated, multi‐faceted vector control strategies for dengue prevention.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热 媒介 控制在减轻登革热感染负担方面发挥着重要作用。传统的荟萃分析只能包括可以直接比较的干预措施。因此,本研究旨在通过多级贝叶斯网络荟萃分析直接和间接比较所有干预措施对登革热 媒介 控制的有效性。方法 包括整群随机对照试验(cRCT)和随机对照试验(RCT)。筛选和全文审阅由两名审稿人独立进行,如果存在分歧,则由第三名审稿人解决。所考虑的纳入研究的测量结果是昆虫学指数和流行病学措施。两名独立评审员使用 Cochrane 偏倚风险工具评估研究质量,并由第三名评审员解决任何差异。结果本研究共纳入48个cRCT和13个RCT。除两项具有低偏倚风险的研究外,cRCT 和 RCT 的质量总体上被认为具有高偏倚风险。网络荟萃分析和叙述综合表明,大多数干预措施并不明显优于其他干预措施。尽管网络荟萃分析缺乏统计上显着的结果,但独立干预措施似乎不如联合干预措施有效。结论 尽管在网络荟萃分析中并未发现大多数干预措施明显优于其他干预措施,但值得注意的是,单独干预措施的效果不如联合干预措施。这些结果强调了促进综合、多方面的 媒介 控制策略对登革热预防的重要性。

papers.title: Deep learning with multiscale spatial context improves global dengue suitability mapping
papers.abstract: Abstract Infectious-disease risk models often rely on occurrence records that are incomplete and spatially biased by surveillance effort, diagnostic access, and outbreak history. Ecological niche modelling (ENM) can identify areas where disease occurrence is environmentally plausible, yet most approaches represent locations using only pointwise covariate values and therefore overlook the surrounding spatial context and rely on presence-only data. Here, we present a deep-learning framework for presence-only data that estimates relative disease suitability by comparing the environmental conditions surrounding reported occurrences with those sampled across the wider study area. The model processes gridded environmental patches at local, neighbourhood, and broader landscape scales, learns the contribution of each scale, and accommodates missing raster values. Using dengue virus as a global case study, we evaluate whether multiscale spatial representation improves upon point-based ENM baselines including random forest and maximum entropy (MaxEnt) under a spatially disjoint train-test design. The model achieved a Boyce index of 0.971 and an AUC of 0.976 on the held-out test set. Learned scale weights and ablation experiments indicated that neighbourhood context contributed most strongly, while local and broader-scale information provided complementary predictive signals. Compared with point-based baselines, the model identified 6–18% more environmentally suitable area across South Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America, encompassing tens of millions of residents. These findings demonstrate that multiscale spatial context can improve estimates of relative dengue suitability. More broadly, mask-aware convolutional density-ratio estimation provides a flexible framework for mapping environmentally structured pathogens from incomplete, presence-only occurrence data.

Ecological niche modelling (ENM) can identify areas where disease occurrence is environmentally plausible, yet most approaches represent locations using only pointwise covariate values and therefore overlook the surrounding spatial context and rely on presence-only data. Here, we present a deep-learning framework for presence-only data that estimates relative disease suitability by comparing the environmental conditions surrounding reported occurrences with those sampled across the wider study area. The model processes gridded environmental patches at local, neighbourhood, and broader landscape scales, learns the contribution of each scale, and accommodates missing raster values. Using dengue virus as a global case study, we evaluate whether multiscale spatial representation improves upon point-based ENM baselines including random forest and maximum entropy (MaxEnt) under a spatially disjoint train-test design. The model achieved a Boyce index of 0.971 and an AUC of 0.976 on the held-out test set. Learned scale weights and ablation experiments indicated that neighbourhood context contributed most strongly, while local and broader-scale information provided complementary predictive signals. Compared with point-based baselines, the model identified 6–18% more environmentally suitable area across South Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America, encompassing tens of millions of residents. These findings demonstrate that multiscale spatial context can improve estimates of relative dengue suitability. More broadly, mask-aware convolutional density-ratio estimation provides a flexible framework for mapping environmentally structured pathogens from incomplete, presence-only occurrence data.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of traditional infectious-disease risk models, which often rely on incomplete and spatially biased occurrence records. Dengue virus is a significant public health concern due to its environmental and geographic variability.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed a spatially disjoint train-test design to evaluate a deep-learning framework for presence-only data. It focused on dengue virus as a global case study, analyzing environmental data across South Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America.
analysis.methods: The model used a deep-learning approach to process gridded environmental patches at local, neighbourhood, and broader landscape scales. It incorporated mask-aware convolutional density-ratio estimation to handle missing raster values and learn the contribution of each spatial scale.
analysis.main_results: The model achieved a Boyce index of 0.971 and an AUC of 0.976 on the held-out test set. It identified 6–18% more environmentally suitable area across South Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America compared to point-based ENM baselines.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that multiscale spatial context can improve estimates of relative dengue suitability. This approach provides a flexible framework for mapping environmentally structured pathogens from incomplete occurrence data.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform more accurate global dengue suitability mapping, aiding in surveillance, risk assessment, and targeted public health interventions in high-risk regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's spatially disjoint train-test design provides moderate confidence in the model's performance. However, the generalizability of the findings may be limited by the specific environmental data used.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a deep-learning framework that improves global dengue suitability mapping by incorporating multiscale spatial context. Traditional models often rely on incomplete and spatially biased occurrence records, making them less effective. The model processes environmental data at local, neighbourhood, and broader landscape scales, learning the contribution of each scale and accommodating missing raster values. It achieved a Boyce index of 0.971 and an AUC of 0.976 on the test set, identifying 6–18% more environmentally suitable areas in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and South America. These findings demonstrate that multiscale spatial representation enhances the accuracy of dengue suitability estimates. The approach offers a flexible framework for mapping pathogens from presence-only data, with potential implications for surveillance and risk assessment. However, the study's spatially disjoint train-test design limits the generalizability of the results, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决传统传染病风险模型的局限性,该模型通常依赖于不完整且存在空间偏差的发生记录。登革病毒 由于其环境和地理变化而成为一个重大的公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用空间不相交的训练测试设计来评估仅存在数据的深度学习框架。它重点关注 登革病毒 作为全球案例研究,分析南亚、东南亚和南美洲的环境数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型使用深度学习方法来处理局部、邻里和更广泛景观尺度的网格化环境斑块。它结合了掩模感知卷积密度比估计来处理丢失的栅格值并了解每个空间尺度的贡献。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型在保留测试集上的博伊斯指数为 0.971,AUC 为 0.976。与基于点的 ENM 基线相比,它发现南亚、东南亚和南美洲的环境适宜区域增加了 6-18%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,多尺度空间背景可以改善对登革热相对适宜性的估计。这种方法提供了一个灵活的框架,用于根据不完整的发生数据绘制环境结构的病原体。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果可以为更准确的全球登革热适宜性绘图提供信息,帮助监测、风险评估和高风险地区的有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的空间不相交的训练测试设计为模型的性能提供了适度的信心。然而,研究结果的普遍性可能受到所使用的具体环境数据的限制。

papers.abstract_zh: 传染病风险模型通常依赖于不完整且因监测努力、诊断获取能力及暴发历史而存在空间偏倚的发生记录。生态位建模(ENM)可识别疾病发生在环境上可行的区域,但大多数方法仅使用点式协变量值表示位点,因此忽略了周围空间背景,且仅依赖存在性数据。本研究提出一种深度学习框架,用于存在性数据,通过比较报告发生点周围环境条件与整个研究区域采样的环境条件,估计相对疾病适宜性。该模型处理局部、邻域及更广泛景观尺度的网格化环境斑块,学习各尺度的贡献,并可容纳缺失栅格值。以登革病毒为全球案例研究,在空间分离的训练-测试设计下,评估多尺度空间表征是否优于点式ENM基线(包括随机森林与最大熵(MaxEnt))。该模型在留存测试集上实现Boyce指数0.971及AUC 0.976。学习到的尺度权重与消融实验显示,邻域背景贡献最强,而局部与更广泛尺度信息提供互补预测信号。与点式基线相比,该模型在南亚、东南亚及南美洲识别出6–18%更多环境适宜区域,覆盖数千万居民。这些发现证明多尺度空间背景可提升登革热相对适宜性估计。更广泛而言,掩码感知卷积密度比估计为利用不完整存在性发生数据绘制环境结构化病原体分布提供了灵活框架。

papers.title: Viral Dynamic Model‐Informed Dose Selection of Mosnodenvir Prophylaxis against DENV‐3 in a Controlled Human Infection Model
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is a significant global health threat. Mosnodenvir (JNJ‐64281802) is a pan‐serotype small molecule antiviral blocking DENV replication. A Phase IIa study (NCT05048875) evaluated the antiviral activity, safety, and pharmacokinetics of mosnodenvir as prophylaxis against DENV‐3 in a controlled human infection model (CHIM). A combined population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) and viral dynamic model (VDM) was developed to estimate the prophylactic effect of mosnodenvir and to inform dose selection. The PopPK model is a two‐compartment model based on plasma pharmacokinetic data from three Phase I studies and Cohort 1 of the Phase IIa study. Mosnodenvir exposure metrics were estimated for participants receiving high, medium, or low doses. A VDM with an immune response compartment adequately described DENV‐3 RNA profiles for placebo participants and was subsequently extended by including a sigmoid E max relationship with average mosnodenvir concentration at steady state ( C avg,ss ) to capture the antiviral effect on virion production rate. Simulations supported daily and weekly mosnodenvir dosing regimens to further characterize the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic relationship in Cohort 2. Based on the complete Phase IIa study data, the basic reproductive number for DENV‐3 in this CHIM was estimated at 21.7, and the typical C avg,ss required to achieve complete virus eradication was estimated to be 1,410 ng/mL. In conclusion, the combined PopPK and VDM approach effectively informed dose selection and characterized the pharmacokinetic‐antiviral activity relationship, supporting the development of mosnodenvir as a prophylactic treatment for dengue infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus infection remains a major global health burden, and there is an unmet need for effective antiviral prophylaxis. The study aimed to determine whether mosnodenvir could prevent DENV-3 replication in humans and to identify an optimal prophylactic dose using model-informed approaches.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A Phase IIa controlled human infection model (CHIM) study (NCT05048875) evaluated mosnodenvir as prophylaxis against DENV-3 in healthy volunteers. Participants received high, medium, or low doses of mosnodenvir or placebo, with pharmacokinetic and viral dynamic data collected to inform dose selection.
analysis.methods: A two-compartment population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) model was built using plasma data from prior Phase I studies and the CHIM Cohort 1. A viral dynamic model (VDM) with an immune response compartment described DENV-3 RNA profiles in placebo participants and was extended to include a sigmoid E max relationship linking antiviral effect to average steady-state mosnodenvir concentration (C avg,ss ). Simulations were performed to characterize the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic relationship and support dosing regimens for Cohort 2.
analysis.main_results: The basic reproductive number for DENV-3 in the CHIM was estimated at 21.7, and the typical C avg,ss required for complete virus eradication was 1,410 ng/mL. Mosnodenvir exposure metrics were estimated across dosing groups, and the combined PopPK-VDM approach demonstrated an antiviral effect on virion production rate.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that integrating PopPK and VDM effectively informed dose selection and characterized the pharmacokinetic–antiviral activity relationship, representing a novel model-informed strategy for dengue antiviral development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support the potential of mosnodenvir as a prophylactic treatment for dengue infection and provide a framework for optimizing antiviral dosing in future clinical trials.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by its small sample size and the use of a controlled human infection model, which may not fully reflect natural dengue transmission dynamics. The evidence strength is moderate, relying on model-based extrapolation and simulation rather than direct clinical efficacy data.

analysis.summary_en: This Phase IIa controlled human infection model study evaluated mosnodenvir as prophylaxis against DENV-3, integrating population pharmacokinetic and viral dynamic modeling to estimate antiviral effects and inform dose selection. A two-compartment PopPK model and an immune-response VDM were used to analyze viral RNA profiles and mosnodenvir exposure metrics across dosing groups. The basic reproductive number for DENV-3 in the CHIM was 21.7, and the target steady-state concentration for complete viral eradication was 1,410 ng/mL. The combined modeling approach demonstrated an antiviral effect on virion production and supported the development of mosnodenvir as a prophylactic dengue treatment. While the study provides a novel model-informed framework, limitations include a small sample size and reliance on CHIM data, warranting cautious interpretation and further clinical validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 抗病毒药物 感染仍然是全球主要的健康负担,有效 抗病毒药物 预防的需求尚未得到满足。该研究旨在确定 mosnodenvir 是否可以阻止 DENV-3 在人类中的复制,并使用基于模型的方法确定最佳预防剂量。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项 IIa 期对照人类感染模型 (CHIM) 研究 (NCT05048875) 评估了莫诺登韦对健康志愿者预防 DENV-3 的作用。参与者接受高、中或低剂量的莫诺登韦或安慰剂,并收集药代动力学和病毒动态数据以指导剂量选择。
elements_zh.methods: 使用先前 I 期研究的血浆数据和 CHIM 队列研究 1 建立了两室群体药代动力学 (PopPK) 模型。具有 免疫应答 室的病毒动力学模型 (VDM) 描述了安慰剂参与者中的 DENV-3 RNA 谱,并扩展到包括将 抗病毒药物 效应与平均稳态莫诺登韦浓度 (C avg,ss) 联系起来的 sigmoid E max 关系)。进行模拟来表征 队列研究 2 的药代动力学/药效关系并支持给药方案。
elements_zh.main_results: CHIM 中 DENV-3 的基本繁殖数估计为 21.7,完全根除病毒所需的典型 C avg,ss 为 1,410 ng/mL。对各剂量组的 Mosnodenvir 暴露指标进行了估计,PopPK-VDM 组合方法证明了 抗病毒药物 对病毒粒子生产率的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,整合 PopPK 和 VDM 可以有效地告知剂量选择,并表征药代动力学 - 抗病毒药物 活性关系,代表了登革热 抗病毒药物 开发的一种新的模型知情策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持莫诺登韦作为登革热感染预防药物 抗病毒药物 的潜力,并为未来临床试验中优化 抗病毒药物 剂量提供了框架。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和使用受控人类感染模型的限制,可能无法完全反映自然登革热 传播 动态。证据强度中等,依赖于基于模型的外推和模拟,而不是直接的临床疗效数据。

papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is a significant global health threat. Mosnodenvir (JNJ‐64281802) is a pan‐serotype small molecule antiviral blocking DENV replication. A Phase IIa study (NCT05048875) evaluated the antiviral activity, safety, and pharmacokinetics of mosnodenvir as prophylaxis against DENV‐3 in a controlled human infection model (CHIM). A combined population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) and viral dynamic model (VDM) was developed to estimate the prophylactic effect of mosnodenvir and to inform dose selection. The PopPK model is a two‐compartment model based on plasma pharmacokinetic data from three Phase I studies and Cohort 1 of the Phase IIa study. Mosnodenvir exposure metrics were estimated for participants receiving high, medium, or low doses. A VDM with an immune response compartment adequately described DENV‐3 RNA profiles for placebo participants and was subsequently extended by including a sigmoid E max relationship with average mosnodenvir concentration at steady state ( C avg,ss ) to capture the antiviral effect on virion production rate. Simulations supported daily and weekly mosnodenvir dosing regimens to further characterize the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic relationship in Cohort 2. Based on the complete Phase IIa study data, the basic reproductive number for DENV‐3 in this CHIM was estimated at 21.7, and the typical C avg,ss required to achieve complete virus eradication was estimated to be 1,410 ng/mL. In conclusion, the combined PopPK and VDM approach effectively informed dose selection and characterized the pharmacokinetic‐antiviral activity relationship, supporting the development of mosnodenvir as a prophylactic treatment for dengue infection.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,整合 PopPK 和 VDM 可以有效地告知剂量选择,并表征药代动力学 - 抗病毒药物 活性关系,代表了登革热 抗病毒药物 开发的一种新的模型知情策略。

papers.title: Dengue fever and chikungunya: prevalence, hematological parameters, and associated factors among febrile patients in eastern Ethiopia: A cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Dengue fever and chikungunya are emerging arboviral diseases and are becoming major public health threats in tropical and subtropical regions. However, the actual burden and contributing factors are not well studied in Ethiopia. Thus, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of dengue fever and chikungunya and assess the hematological parameters and associated factors among febrile patients in eastern Ethiopia. An institution-based cross-sectional study was conducted in Dire Dawa city administration from October to December 2023. Sociodemographic and clinical information of patients were collected using a structured questionnaire and checklist. Hematological parameters were determined using the Mindray BC-3000 Plus automated hematology analyzer. The Kruskal–Wallis test, Spearman correlation test, and logistic regression were used during data analysis. A P-value of < .05 with a 95% confidence interval was considered statistically significant. A total of 576 febrile patients were investigated. The majority of the study participants, 312 (54.2%), were male, and 524 (91%) were rural residents. Nearly 327 (57%) cases were diagnosed with dengue fever, while 73 (13%) cases were for chikungunya. The type of visited healthcare institution (Sabian Comprehensive Hospital, AOR: 8.2 [95% CI: 4.02, 17.3] and Dilchora Referral Hospital, AOR: 2.3 [95% CI: 1.5, 3.7]), urban residence (AOR: 2.3, 95% CI: 1.37–7.7), government employment (AOR: 0.34 [0.12–0.99]), and patients’ previous history of a similar AFI (acute febrile illness) AOR: 3.2 (95% CI: 1.02, 10.3) were significantly associated with empiric arboviral diseases. White blood cell, red blood cell, and platelet counts were significantly decreased among patients with DENV infection compared to other febrile patients (P < .001). In addition, a statistically significant weak negative correlation was noted between the duration of fever and white blood cell count, red blood cell count, and platelet count among dengue patients. High rates of clinical dengue fever and chikungunya cases were observed. Some socio-demographic and institutional factors were more likely to be significantly associated with clinically diagnosed arboviral diseases. Furthermore, significant differences were observed in some hematological parameters between cases with dengue/chikungunya diseases and those without. The findings highlighted the need for early diagnosis and urgent action to downplay the undesirable outcomes of arboviral diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 和基孔肯雅热被认为是新出现的虫媒病毒性疾病,对热带和亚热带地区的公共卫生构成重大威胁,但在埃塞俄比亚,它们的实际负担和影响因素尚未得到充分研究。

elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化问卷和检查表收集社会人口学和临床数据,并使用迈瑞 BC-3000 Plus 自动血液分析仪测定血液学参数。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了临床诊断的登革热和基孔肯雅热病例的高发生率,以及某些社会人口和制度因素与虫媒病毒疾病之间的显着关联,强调了早期 诊断 的必要性。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横断面设计限制了因果推断,在没有实验室确认 诊断 感染的情况下依赖临床 诊断 会降低特异性;因此,证据强度中等。

papers.title_zh: 登革热 和基孔肯雅热:埃塞俄比亚东部发热患者的 患病率、血液学参数和相关因素:一项横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever and chikungunya are emerging arboviral diseases and are becoming major public health threats in tropical and subtropical regions. However, the actual burden and contributing factors are not well studied in Ethiopia. Thus, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of dengue fever and chikungunya and assess the hematological parameters and associated factors among febrile patients in eastern Ethiopia. An institution-based cross-sectional study was conducted in Dire Dawa city administration from October to December 2023. Sociodemographic and clinical information of patients were collected using a structured questionnaire and checklist. Hematological parameters were determined using the Mindray BC-3000 Plus automated hematology analyzer. The Kruskal–Wallis test, Spearman correlation test, and logistic regression were used during data analysis. A P-value of < .05 with a 95% confidence interval was considered statistically significant. A total of 576 febrile patients were investigated. The majority of the study participants, 312 (54.2%), were male, and 524 (91%) were rural residents. Nearly 327 (57%) cases were diagnosed with dengue fever, while 73 (13%) cases were for chikungunya. The type of visited healthcare institution (Sabian Comprehensive Hospital, AOR: 8.2 [95% CI: 4.02, 17.3] and Dilchora Referral Hospital, AOR: 2.3 [95% CI: 1.5, 3.7]), urban residence (AOR: 2.3, 95% CI: 1.37–7.7), government employment (AOR: 0.34 [0.12–0.99]), and patients’ previous history of a similar AFI (acute febrile illness) AOR: 3.2 (95% CI: 1.02, 10.3) were significantly associated with empiric arboviral diseases. White blood cell, red blood cell, and platelet counts were significantly decreased among patients with DENV infection compared to other febrile patients (P < .001). In addition, a statistically significant weak negative correlation was noted between the duration of fever and white blood cell count, red blood cell count, and platelet count among dengue patients. High rates of clinical dengue fever and chikungunya cases were observed. Some socio-demographic and institutional factors were more likely to be significantly associated with clinically diagnosed arboviral diseases. Furthermore, significant differences were observed in some hematological parameters between cases with dengue/chikungunya diseases and those without. The findings highlighted the need for early diagnosis and urgent action to downplay the undesirable outcomes of arboviral diseases.

papers.title: The disappearance, and re-emergence of Aedes aegypti in Iran: historical and current status, rising dengue fever threat
papers.abstract: Aedes aegypti is the proven vector of dengue fever, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. In Iran, the first recorded sighting of Ae. aegypti dates back to 1920 and into the early 1950s. For 70 years, the species was not seen in the country. However, since 2018, reports have confirmed the presence of Ae. aegypti in various regions. It is now established in some areas of the southern provinces, including Hormozgan, Bushehr, and Sistan and Baluchistan. The appearance, disappearance, and subsequent re-emergence of Ae. aegypti in Iran, after a 70-year absence, are attributed to a combination of factors such as historical malaria control, infrastructure, globalization, urbanization, and climate change that is discussed in this study. This study underscores that the re-emergence of Ae. aegypti in Iran necessitates an urgent paradigm shift from reactive chemical-based control toward a proactive, integrated management framework. Ultimately, the long-term mitigation of dengue fever risk depends on the seamless integration of community-based environmental management with advanced biotechnological interventions.
papers.journal: Journal of Environmental Health Science and Engineering

papers.title: Transmisión vertical de Dengue: Reporte de un caso neonatal en un centro de alta complejidad en Guayaquil, Ecuador.
papers.abstract: Vertical transmission of neonatal dengue presents a diagnostic challenge in hyperendemic areas such as Guayaquil. We report the case of a female neonate, the daughter of a pregnant woman who died from severe peripartum dengue. The patient was admitted with severe perinatal asphyxia, renal injury, and myocardial damage. analysis.research_question_and_background: Vertical transmission of neonatal dengue presents a diagnostic challenge in hyperendemic areas such as Guayaquil. The study aimed to document a case of vertical dengue transmission and highlight its clinical implications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study reports a case of a female neonate, the daughter of a pregnant woman who died from severe peripartum dengue, admitted to a high-complexity center in Guayaquil, Ecuador. The patient was observed over 14 days with multidisciplinary follow-up.
analysis.methods: The patient was admitted with severe perinatal asphyxia, renal injury, and myocardial damage. Dynamic fluid management was employed to stabilize the patient without the need for blood products. The diagnosis was confirmed by a positive NS1 antigen test on the fifth day.
analysis.main_results: The neonate developed fever and a rash on the fifth day, and the diagnosis was confirmed by a positive NS1 antigen test. Grade 2 intraventricular hemorrhage was also documented.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: This case highlights the potential for vertical dengue transmission and the importance of timely perinatal detection to prevent mortality associated with severe complications.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for increased awareness and surveillance of dengue in neonates, an underreported age group, and underscore the importance of early diagnosis and intervention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a single case report, which limits the generalizability of the findings. However, the evidence is strong due to the detailed clinical documentation and confirmation of dengue through NS1 antigen testing.

analysis.summary_en: This case report documents a neonate who developed dengue infection following vertical transmission from a mother who died from severe peripartum dengue. The patient presented with severe perinatal asphyxia, renal injury, and myocardial damage, and was diagnosed with dengue on the fifth day through a positive NS1 antigen test. She also exhibited Grade 2 intraventricular hemorrhage. Dynamic fluid management allowed for stabilization without blood products, and she was discharged after 14 days with multidisciplinary follow-up. The case underscores the diagnostic challenges of vertical dengue transmission in hyperendemic areas and highlights the importance of timely perinatal detection to prevent mortality. While the study is limited to a single case, the evidence is strong due to the clinical confirmation and detailed documentation. This case raises awareness about dengue in neonates, an underreported age group, and suggests the need for improved surveillance and diagnostic protocols.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 新生儿登革热的垂直 传播 在瓜亚基尔等高流行地区提出了诊断挑战。该研究旨在记录垂直登革热 传播 病例并强调其临床意义。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究报告了一名女性新生儿的病例,她是一名死于严重围产期登革热的孕妇的女儿,被送往厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔的一个高度复杂的中心。对患者进行了超过 14 天的多学科随访观察。
elements_zh.methods: 该患者因严重围产期窒息、肾损伤和心肌损伤而入院。采用动态液体管理来稳定患者而不需要血液制品。第五天,NS1 抗原检测呈阳性,证实了 诊断。
elements_zh.main_results: 新生儿第五天出现发热和皮疹,NS1抗原检测呈阳性,确诊为诊断。还记录了 2 级脑室内出血。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例强调了垂直登革热 传播 的可能性,以及及时围产期检测以预防 死亡率 与严重并发症相关的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要提高对新生儿(报告不足的年龄组)登革热的认识和 监测,并强调早期 监测 和干预的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于单个 病例报告,这限制了研究结果的普遍性。然而,由于详细的临床文件和通过 NS1 抗原检测确认登革热,证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Evidence of dengue transmission and a diverse Aedes mosquito virome on the Congo’s Angola border
papers.abstract: Abstract Aedes mosquitoes are widely distributed across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and are major vectors of dengue (DENV), Zika, chikungunya (CHIKV), and yellow fever (YFV) viruses. While the high burden of malaria in the DRC receives considerable attention, arboviruses remain understudied. In the setting of recent CHIKV and YFV outbreaks in southwestern DRC, we collect Aedes mosquitoes in three areas of Kimpese, DRC, near the Angola border, to investigate their virome. Metagenomic and targeted sequencing of eight randomly selected field mosquito pools, comprising 155 mosquitoes from three collection sites, confirm high-confidence DENV reads and human blood meals in six (75%) and eight (100%) pools, respectively. We find diverse mosquito viromes including other known and putative human and animal viruses. Our findings provide strong evidence of endemic DENV transmission along the DRC-Angola border and illustrate the potential of wild-caught mosquitoes for xenosurveillance of emerging pathogens.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue remains understudied in the Democratic Republic of Congo despite the presence of Aedes mosquitoes that transmit it, and recent outbreaks of other arboviruses in the region highlighted a knowledge gap about local dengue transmission dynamics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study collected Aedes mosquitoes in three areas of Kimpese, DRC, near the Angola border, to investigate their virome in the context of recent chikungunya and yellow fever outbreaks.
analysis.methods: Metagenomic and targeted sequencing were performed on eight randomly selected field mosquito pools comprising 155 mosquitoes from three collection sites to identify viral reads and blood meals.
analysis.main_results: High-confidence dengue virus reads were confirmed in six of eight mosquito pools (75%), and human blood meals were detected in all eight pools (100%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as strong evidence of endemic dengue virus transmission along the DRC-Angola border and highlight the utility of wild-caught mosquitoes for xenosurveillance of emerging pathogens.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results support targeted surveillance and control measures for dengue in southwestern DRC and demonstrate a practical approach for monitoring arboviral activity using mosquito viromes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and reliance on mosquito pools rather than individual-level data, which constrains generalizability and precise risk assessment, warranting moderate confidence in the evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated dengue virus transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo by collecting Aedes mosquitoes near the Angola border following recent chikungunya and yellow fever outbreaks. Using metagenomic and targeted sequencing of eight mosquito pools totaling 155 individuals, the authors detected high-confidence dengue virus reads in 75% of pools and human blood meals in all pools. These findings provide strong evidence of endemic dengue transmission in the region and demonstrate the potential of wild-caught mosquitoes for xenosurveillance of emerging arboviruses. The study’s small sample size and pooled sampling approach limit generalizability and precise risk estimation, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains one of the most rapidly expanding vector-borne diseases worldwide, driven by complex interactions between host, vector, environment, and increasingly, human mobility. Despite significant advances in mathematical epidemiology, existing models often rely on simplifying assumptions that neglect critical transmission pathways, particularly the role of asymptomatic infections and the implicit influence of population movement. In this study, we develop a rigorous host–vector dengue model that incorporates asymptomatic transmission within a mechanistic and analytically tractable framework, providing a foundational step toward mobility-driven epidemiological modeling. We establish the well-posedness of the model by proving positivity, boundedness, and the existence of invariant regions. The basic reproduction number, \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathcal {R}_0$$\end{document}, is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and its epidemiological interpretation is examined in the presence of asymptomatic carriers. A comprehensive qualitative analysis is conducted, including the local and global stability of the disease-free equilibrium, with global stability established via Lyapunov methods. Conditions for the existence of endemic equilibria are obtained, revealing the fundamental role of asymptomatic transmission in sustaining disease persistence. To quantify the relative impact of model parameters, a sensitivity analysis of \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathcal {R}_0$$\end{document} is performed, identifying key drivers of transmission and highlighting the dominant influence of vector-related parameters and asymptomatic infectivity. Furthermore, an optimal control framework is formulated incorporating vector control, transmission reduction, and treatment strategies. Using Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle, we derive the necessary optimality conditions and characterize the structure of optimal intervention policies. Numerical simulations illustrate the effectiveness of combined control strategies and demonstrate the limitations of single-intervention approaches. The results underscore the critical importance of accounting for asymptomatic transmission in dengue dynamics and provide a mathematically rigorous baseline for future extensions incorporating spatial heterogeneity and human mobility. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 仍然是全球范围内传播最迅速的 媒介 传播疾病之一,其驱动因素是 媒介、媒介、环境以及日益增长的人员流动之间复杂的相互作用。尽管数学 流行病学 取得了重大进展,但现有模型通常依赖于简化假设,而忽略了关键的 传播 途径,特别是无症状感染的作用和人口流动的隐含影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项研究中,我们开发了严格的 宿主–媒介 登革热模型,该模型将无症状 传播 纳入机械和分析易处理的框架内,为迈向流动驱动的流行病学建模奠定了基础。
elements_zh.methods: 我们通过证明正性、有界性和不变区域的存在性来建立模型的适定性。基本再生数 $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ 是使用下一代矩阵方法得出的,并在无症状携带者存在的情况下检查其流行病学解释。进行了全面的定性分析,包括无病平衡的局部和全局稳定性,并通过李雅普诺夫方法建立了全局稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 获得了地方病平衡存在的条件,揭示了无症状 传播 在维持疾病持续性中的基本作用。对 $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ 进行敏感性分析,确定 传播 的关键驱动因素,并强调 媒介 相关参数和无症状感染性的主导影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果强调了在登革热动力学中考虑无症状 传播 的至关重要性,并为未来纳入空间异质性和人类流动性的扩展提供了严格的数学基线。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这项工作弥合了经典区室模型和更现实的流行病学环境之间的差距,为在日益相互联系的人群中设计有效的登革热控制策略提供了理论见解和实际意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据并未报告研究设计或样本量的局限性。研究结果的可信度很高,因为该研究提供了严格的数学框架并确定了登革热 传播 的关键驱动因素。

papers.title_zh: 无症状传播登革热模型的定性分析和优化控制
papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever remains one of the most rapidly expanding vector-borne diseases worldwide, driven by complex interactions between host, vector, environment, and increasingly, human mobility. Despite significant advances in mathematical epidemiology, existing models often rely on simplifying assumptions that neglect critical transmission pathways, particularly the role of asymptomatic infections and the implicit influence of population movement. In this study, we develop a rigorous host–vector dengue model that incorporates asymptomatic transmission within a mechanistic and analytically tractable framework, providing a foundational step toward mobility-driven epidemiological modeling. We establish the well-posedness of the model by proving positivity, boundedness, and the existence of invariant regions. The basic reproduction number, \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathcal {R}_0$$\end{document}, is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and its epidemiological interpretation is examined in the presence of asymptomatic carriers. A comprehensive qualitative analysis is conducted, including the local and global stability of the disease-free equilibrium, with global stability established via Lyapunov methods. Conditions for the existence of endemic equilibria are obtained, revealing the fundamental role of asymptomatic transmission in sustaining disease persistence. To quantify the relative impact of model parameters, a sensitivity analysis of \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathcal {R}_0$$\end{document} is performed, identifying key drivers of transmission and highlighting the dominant influence of vector-related parameters and asymptomatic infectivity. Furthermore, an optimal control framework is formulated incorporating vector control, transmission reduction, and treatment strategies. Using Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle, we derive the necessary optimality conditions and characterize the structure of optimal intervention policies. Numerical simulations illustrate the effectiveness of combined control strategies and demonstrate the limitations of single-intervention approaches. The results underscore the critical importance of accounting for asymptomatic transmission in dengue dynamics and provide a mathematically rigorous baseline for future extensions incorporating spatial heterogeneity and human mobility. This work bridges the gap between classical compartmental models and more realistic epidemiological settings, offering both theoretical insights and practical implications for the design of effective dengue control strategies in increasingly interconnected populations.

papers.title: Long Short-Term Memory-Based Multivariate Forecasting Model for Dengue: A Case Study in Sri Lanka
papers.abstract: Dengue fever has been a significant health concern in Sri Lanka since the 1960s. The number of cases has drastically increased over the last decade. Different statistical and classical machine learning models have been proposed to forecast dengue in order to mitigate the disease from reaching its high transmission rate. More recently, the advent of neural networks has improved prognosis in an efficient manner through time forecasting of dengue data using multiple predictor variables. Understanding the strength of long short-term memory (LSTM) models in the past, this specific research has evaluated three variants of LSTM models: unidirectional LSTM, bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), and encoder-decoder LSTM, with the aim of predicting dengue occurrences in Sri Lanka. Weather data, including rainfall and mean temperature, were used as predictors while the efficiency of the models was assessed using RMSE. While all three models exhibited relatively good performance, the BiLSTM model significantly outperformed the other two models. This study affirms the use of LSTM for predicting dengue-like vector-borne diseases that are characterized by complex relationships with the predictors.

papers.title_zh: 基于长期短期记忆的登革热多元预测模型:斯里兰卡案例研究
papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever has been a significant health concern in Sri Lanka since the 1960s. The number of cases has drastically increased over the last decade. Different statistical and classical machine learning models have been proposed to forecast dengue in order to mitigate the disease from reaching its high transmission rate. More recently, the advent of neural networks has improved prognosis in an efficient manner through time forecasting of dengue data using multiple predictor variables. Understanding the strength of long short-term memory (LSTM) models in the past, this specific research has evaluated three variants of LSTM models: unidirectional LSTM, bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), and encoder-decoder LSTM, with the aim of predicting dengue occurrences in Sri Lanka. Weather data, including rainfall and mean temperature, were used as predictors while the efficiency of the models was assessed using RMSE. While all three models exhibited relatively good performance, the BiLSTM model significantly outperformed the other two models. This study affirms the use of LSTM for predicting dengue-like vector-borne diseases that are characterized by complex relationships with the predictors.

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Modeling of Dengue in Argentina (2009–2025): Risk Factors, spatial patterns, and implications for prevention planning
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue has expanded markedly in Argentina, with Aedes aegypti now established in temperate provinces and successive epidemics culminating in a record outbreak in 2024. Disentangling large-scale inter-annual climate variability from local environmental and socio-infrastructural conditions is essential for targeted prevention, yet few studies have modelled dengue determinants across Argentina’s heterogeneous transmission zones at national scale. Methods We analysed 817,699 dengue cases reported across 473 departments in northern and central Argentina from 2009 to 2025 using Bayesian hierarchical spatio-temporal models within the integrated nested Laplace approximation (INLA) framework. A zero-inflated negative binomial distribution accounted for overdispersion and excess zeros; spatial, temporal and space–time random effects were combined with climatic, environmental and sociodemographic covariates, and predictive performance was assessed through forward-chaining temporal cross-validation. Results Dengue incidence showed strong inter-annual variability, peaking in 2024. El Niño years carried markedly higher risk independent of seasonal climate. Higher current-summer temperature and relative humidity were associated with increased risk, while previous-spring temperature showed a non-linear carry-over relationship with subsequent transmission. Populations living near waste-disposal sites were at greater risk. The model reliably identified high-risk department-years, including the 2024 epidemic, although forecasting outbreak magnitude remained more challenging. Conclusions Large-scale climate variability, seasonal weather and local environmental factors jointly shape dengue transmission in Argentina. Bayesian risk mapping can guide targeted prevention and seasonal early-warning systems, particularly along the expanding southern transmission frontier.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue has expanded into temperate provinces of Argentina with successive epidemics, yet the relative contributions of large-scale climate variability versus local environmental and socio-infrastructural factors remain insufficiently disentangled for targeted prevention at national scale.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nationwide ecological analysis was conducted using 817,699 dengue cases reported across 473 departments in northern and central Argentina from 2009 to 2025.
analysis.methods: Bayesian hierarchical spatio-temporal models within the INLA framework were applied, using a zero-inflated negative binomial distribution to handle overdispersion and excess zeros, and incorporating climatic, environmental and sociodemographic covariates with forward-chaining temporal cross-validation for predictive performance assessment.
analysis.main_results: Dengue incidence exhibited strong inter-annual variability with a peak in 2024, higher current-summer temperature and relative humidity were associated with increased risk, and El Niño years carried markedly higher risk independent of seasonal climate.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study concludes that large-scale climate variability, seasonal weather and local environmental factors jointly shape dengue transmission in Argentina, and demonstrates that Bayesian risk mapping can identify high-risk department-years including the 2024 epidemic.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the development of targeted prevention and seasonal early-warning systems, particularly along the expanding southern transmission frontier where Aedes aegypti is becoming established.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Forecasting outbreak magnitude remained more challenging than identifying high-risk areas, indicating a limitation in predictive precision despite reliable risk mapping.

analysis.summary_en: This nationwide ecological study in Argentina analyzed 817,699 dengue cases from 473 departments (2009–2025) using Bayesian spatio-temporal models to disentangle drivers of transmission. Strong inter-annual variability was observed with a 2024 peak, and El Niño years independently increased risk. Higher summer temperature and humidity were associated with increased incidence, while a non-linear carry-over effect from previous-spring temperature was noted. The model reliably identified high-risk department-years, including the 2024 epidemic, but forecasting outbreak magnitude proved more difficult. The authors conclude that climate variability, seasonal weather and local environmental factors jointly shape transmission and propose that Bayesian risk mapping can guide targeted prevention and seasonal early-warning systems, especially along the expanding southern frontier.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热已蔓延至阿根廷温带省份并连续流行,但大规模气候变化与当地环境和社会基础设施因素的相对影响仍不足以在全国范围内进行有针对性的预防。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 利用 2009 年至 2025 年阿根廷北部和中部 473 个省份报告的 817,699 例登革热病例进行了全国性生态分析。
elements_zh.methods: 应用 INLA 框架内的贝叶斯分层时空模型,使用零膨胀负二项分布来处理过度分散和过量零,并将气候、环境和社会人口统计协变量与前向链时间交叉验证相结合以进行预测性能评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 登革热 发病率 表现出强烈的年际变化,在 2024 年达到峰值,当前夏季较高的温度和相对湿度与风险增加相关,而厄尔尼诺年份的风险明显较高,与季节气候无关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究得出的结论是,大范围的气候变化、季节性天气和当地环境因素共同影响了阿根廷的登革热传播,并证明贝叶斯风险图可以识别包括2024年疫情在内的高风险部门年份。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持开发有针对性的预防和季节性预警系统,特别是在埃及伊蚊正在扎根的不断扩大的南部 传播 边境地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 预测 暴发 的震级仍然比识别高风险区域更具挑战性,这表明尽管有可靠的风险映射,但预测精度仍然有限​​。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 利用 2009 年至 2025 年阿根廷北部和中部 473 个省份报告的 817,699 例登革热病例进行了全国性生态分析。

papers.title: Perception and knowledge of the population about dengue fever in a municipality in Northeast of Brazil
papers.abstract: Objective: to evaluate knowledge, habits, and participation in educational activities on dengue among residents of the municipality of Lago do Junco, Maranhão, Brazil. Methodology: this is an observational, cross-sectional study conducted with 264 individuals over 18 years of age, randomly selected. A structured questionnaire was applied, including sociodemographic variables and questions related to the etiological agent, transmission, symptoms, treatment, prevention, and household practices. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and the Chi-square test, with a significance level of 5%. Results: a total of 264 individuals were interviewed, of whom 62.1% were female, 37.0% were aged between 35 and 59 years, and 26.1% had completed high school. Most participants demonstrated satisfactory knowledge about dengue: 91.7% correctly recognized the main signs and symptoms, 80.3% adequately identified prevention methods, and 64.0% correctly indicated transmission through mosquito bites. However, 59.1% reported the presence of water-holding containers in their households, favoring vector proliferation. In addition, 54.2% reported having participated in educational activities. A statistically significant association was observed between higher education level and greater knowledge about the disease (p < 0.05). Conclusion: although the population's knowledge is satisfactory, risky household practices still persist. Therefore, it is necessary to expand and strengthen continuous educational actions, especially targeting more vulnerable groups, aiming to reduce risk behaviors and effectively control dengue in the municipality.

A structured questionnaire was applied, including sociodemographic variables and questions related to the etiological agent, transmission, symptoms, treatment, prevention, and household practices. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and the Chi-square test, with a significance level of 5%. Results: a total of 264 individuals were interviewed, of whom 62.1% were female, 37.0% were aged between 35 and 59 years, and 26.1% had completed high school. Most participants demonstrated satisfactory knowledge about dengue: 91.7% correctly recognized the main signs and symptoms, 80.3% adequately identified prevention methods, and 64.0% correctly indicated transmission through mosquito bites. However, 59.1% reported the presence of water-holding containers in their households, favoring vector proliferation. In addition, 54.2% reported having participated in educational activities. A statistically significant association was observed between higher education level and greater knowledge about the disease (p < 0.05). Conclusion: although the population's knowledge is satisfactory, risky household practices still persist. Therefore, it is necessary to expand and strengthen continuous educational actions, especially targeting more vulnerable groups, aiming to reduce risk behaviors and effectively control dengue in the municipality.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项观察性横断面研究,研究对象为 264 名 18 岁以上的个体,这些个体是从巴西马拉尼昂州 Lago do Junco 市随机抽取的。该研究于2024年至2025年间进行。
elements_zh.methods: 采用结构化调查问卷,包括社会人口统计学变量以及与病因、传播、症状、治疗、预防和家庭实践相关的问题。使用描述性统计和卡方检验对数据进行分析,显着性水平为5%。
elements_zh.main_results: 共有 264 人接受采访,其中 62.1% 为女性,37.0% 年龄在 35 岁至 59 岁之间,26.1% 完成高中学业。大多数参与者对登革热的了解令人满意:91.7% 的人正确识别了主要体征和症状,80.3% 的人充分识别了预防方法,64.0% 的人通过蚊虫叮咬正确指示了 传播。然而,59.1% 的人表示家里有盛水的容器,这有利于 媒介 的扩散。此外,54.2%的人表示曾参加过教育活动。较高的教育水平与对该疾病的更多了解之间存在统计学上显着的关联(p < 0.05)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,尽管人们的知识水平令人满意,但危险的家庭做法仍然存在。这项研究为教育水平与登革热知识之间的关系提供了新颖的见解,强调了有针对性的教育干预措施的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过强调教育活动的重要性来为公共卫生战略提供信息,以提高知识并改变与登革热预防相关的危险行为。这有助于制定更有效的基于社区的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,不允许进行因果推断。由于依赖自我报告的数据和潜在的回忆偏差,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Clinical and Biochemical Characteristics of Dengue Fever and Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever During the 2024 Dengue Outbreak
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue is a vector-borne viral infection that poses a significant public health threat in tropical and subtropical regions, ranging from mild fever to severe forms like DHF and DSS. Gender and platelet count are thought to influence disease severity, but their roles remain unclear. Objective: This study aims to explore the demographic, clinical, and laboratory characteristics of dengue patients, focusing on gender differences and platelet count’s association. Methodology: This was a prospective study carried out in the Department of Virology in NILMRC, Dhaka, Bangladesh from July to November 2024. The study population comprised confirmed dengue patients admitted to the Medicine Ward of AMZ Hospital during the study period, as well as outdoor patients from NILMRC, who met the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Serology and RT PCR were performed. Results: 57.9% were male and 42.1% were female, with a higher prevalence of dengue among males. The majority of patients were in the 16-25 (30.1%) and 26-35 (29.5%) age groups. Gender differences were observed in clinical features: males more frequently reported cough, headache, myalgia, fatigue, joint pain, and low platelet count, while females had a higher incidence of rash and nausea/vomiting. A higher proportion of males (8.2%) experienced severe complications like DHF/DSS.84.2% having platelet counts >100,000 cells/μL. Elevated liver enzymes (AST and ALT) were observed in 42.5% and 37% of patients, respectively. DENV-2 was the predominant serotype (61%). Lower platelet counts (≤100,000 cells/μL) were associated with higher incidences of severe complications, elevated AST and ALT levels, and hematocrit rise >20%. Conclusion: This study highlights significant gender differences in the clinical presentation and severity of dengue, with males more frequently experiencing musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, and severe complications like DHF and DSS. Platelet count emerged as a key marker for predicting severe outcomes. Journal of Monno Medical College December, 2025;11(2):113-120

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是一种由 媒介 传播的病毒感染,对热带和亚热带地区的公共卫生构成重大威胁,从轻度发烧到 DHF 和 DSS 等严重形式。性别和血小板计数被认为会影响疾病的严重程度,但它们的作用仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是2024年7月至11月在孟加拉国达卡NILMRC病毒学系进行的一项前瞻性研究。研究人群包括研究期间入住AMZ医院内科病房的确诊登革热患者,以及符合纳入和排除标准的来自NILMRC的户外患者。
elements_zh.methods: 进行血清学和RT PCR。大多数患者年龄在 16-25 岁(30.1%)和 26-35 岁(29.5%)年龄段。
elements_zh.main_results: 57.9%为男性,42.1%为女性,其中男性登革热患病率较高。临床特征存在性别差异:男性更常报告咳嗽、头痛、肌痛、疲劳、关节痛和血小板计数低,而女性则更常报告皮疹和恶心/呕吐。较高比例的男性 (8.2%) 经历过 DHF/DSS 等严重并发症。84.2% 的血小板计数 >100,000 个细胞/μL。分别有 42.5% 和 37% 的患者出现肝酶(AST 和 ALT)升高。DENV-2 是主要血清型 (61%)。较低的血小板计数(≤100,000 个细胞/μL)与较高的 发病率 严重并发症、AST 和 ALT 水平升高以及血细胞比容升高 >20% 相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究强调了登革热临床表现和严重程度的显着性别差异,男性更容易出现肌肉骨骼疼痛、疲劳以及 DHF 和 DSS 等严重并发症。血小板计数成为预测严重后果的关键标志。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为登革热的针对性 监测 和管理策略提供信息,特别是在识别严重疾病的危险因素并指导基于性别和血小板计数的临床决策方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在孟加拉国的一个中心进行的,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是中等的,因为它基于特定 暴发 时期的观察数据。

papers.title: Social network analysis and exponential random graph modelling of dengue spatiotemporal linkage networks in an urban Malaysian district
papers.abstract: Dengue burden is increasingly concentrated in rapidly urbanising Asian cities, yet routine surveillance rarely captures fine-scale residential spatiotemporal co-occurrence. We characterised a case-level linkage network and identified sociodemographic and residential correlates of linkage formation in Petaling District, Malaysia, using social network analysis and exponential random graph models (ERGMs). Cases were linked when their residences were within 200 m and symptom onset occurred within 14 days. Among 19,549 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases reported in 2023, 12,978 had at least one linkage, forming 21,424 linkages in a highly fragmented network. Linkages represent residential co-occurrence rather than confirmed transmission. Among connected cases, the conditional odds of linkage were elevated for pairs of high-rise residents (OR 6.66, 95% CI 6.40–6.93), low-rise residents (OR 4.34, 95% CI 4.15–4.54) and non-citizen cases (OR 3.96, 95% CI 3.70–4.22). Student status was modestly associated with linkage formation (OR 1.07, 95% CI 1.05–1.10). Degree-related structural dependence was not supported. Attribute associations were more stable than structural dependence across evaluated network definitions. Integrating linkage analysis into routine surveillance could support targeted prioritisation of vector control in high-rise buildings and priority communities when operational capacity is constrained.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterise the spatiotemporal linkage networks of dengue cases in Petaling District, Malaysia, using social network analysis and exponential random graph models (ERGMs). The research focused on identifying sociodemographic and residential factors associated with the formation of these linkages. Among 19,549 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in 2023, 12,978 had at least one linkage, forming 21,424 linkages in a highly fragmented network. The findings suggest that linkages reflect residential co-occurrence rather than direct transmission. The study highlights the potential of integrating linkage analysis into routine surveillance to guide targeted vector control efforts in high-rise buildings and priority communities. The results indicate that attribute associations, such as high-rise and low-rise residency, were more stable than structural dependence across evaluated network definitions. However, the evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength.

papers.title: Digital Surveillance for Vector Control: Deployment and Evaluation of a Web-Based Dengue Monitoring System in Colombia
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Digital technologies are increasingly used in public health to improve data management and strengthen disease-control operations. This study describes the design, development, and field testing of a web-based software system—Digital Surveillance of Vector Control (DSVC)—to monitor and evaluate vector control programs. The system was deployed during a large-scale intervention using a novel larvicidal/adulticidal protective coating (PC) applied to domestic water containers, the main larval habitat of dengue-transmitting Aedes mosquitoes in many tropical cities. A field study was conducted in Cúcuta and Los Patios, Colombia, to assess the potential of DSVC to reduce data processing time, improve accuracy, and support timely decision-making. Methodology: DSVC was developed to optimize data processing and monitoring vector control activities. It was tested under real operational conditions by integrating data collected by community volunteers during visits to approximately 8,000 households. Two data-collection methods were compared: traditional paper forms and the Epicollect5 mobile application. The principal investigator monitored real-time data processing, analysis, and visualization through DSVC. In-depth interviews with municipal data management engineers assessed the system’s potential integration into local health services. Focus group discussions with community volunteers and vector control technicians explored acceptance, usability, and perceived advantages and limitations of Epicollect5. Results DSVC reduced data processing time and improved accuracy compared to paper-based workflows. The system efficiently managed large data volumes and enabled rapid aggregation and visualization of data. Municipal vector control technicians reported that DSVC met key requirements for monitoring vector control activities. Interviews and focus groups indicated positive acceptance of digital tools, highlighting their potential for adoption in routine programs. Epicollect5 facilitated integration of paper-based and digital data, reduced errors, and accelerated data capture. However, fieldwork revealed risks of device theft and persistent preference for paper forms in some neighborhoods. Conclusion DSVC and Epicollect5 enhanced the efficiency of data collection and analysis, enabling faster and more targeted responses. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 数字技术越来越多地应用于公共卫生领域,以改善数据管理并加强疾病控制行动。本研究描述了基于网络的软件系统(媒介 Control (DSVC) 的数字 监测)的设计、开发和现场测试,以监视和评估 媒介 控制程序。该系统是在大规模干预期间部署的,使用一种新型杀幼虫/杀成虫保护涂层(PC)应用于家用水容器,这是许多热带城市传播登革热的伊蚊的主要幼虫栖息地。在哥伦比亚库库塔和洛斯帕蒂奥斯进行了一项实地研究,以评估 DSVC 在减少数据处理时间、提高准确性和支持及时决策方面的潜力。方法:DSVC 的开发是为了优化数据处理和监控 媒介 控制活动。该系统通过整合社区志愿者走访约 8,000 个家庭期间收集的数据,在实际操作条件下进行了测试。比较了两种数据收集方法:传统纸质表格和 Epicollect5 移动应用程序。首席研究员通过 DSVC 监控实时数据处理、分析和可视化。对市政数据管理工程师的深入采访评估了该系统融入当地卫生服务的潜力。与社区志愿者和 媒介 控制技术人员进行的焦点小组讨论探讨了 Epicollect5 的接受度、可用性以及感知的优点和局限性。结果 与纸质工作流程相比,DSVC 减少了数据处理时间并提高了准确性。该系统有效管理大量数据,并实现数据的快速聚合和可视化。市政 媒介 控制技术人员报告称,DSVC 满足监测 媒介 控制活动的关键要求。访谈和焦点小组表明对数字工具的积极接受,强调了它们在常规项目中采用的潜力。Epicollect5 促进了纸质数据和数字数据的集成,减少了错误并加速了数据捕获。然而,实地调查显示,一些社区存在设备被盗的风险以及对纸质表格的持续偏好。结论 DSVC 和 Epicollect5 提高了数据收集和分析的效率,从而实现更快、更有针对性的响应。数字工具代表了优化 媒介 控制程序的重大进步。市政部门确定了该系统未来整合的潜力,有待行政决策。用户接受度、操作可行性和清晰的工作流程对于最大化 媒介 控制中数字工具的影响至关重要。

papers.title: Urban Hyperendemicity and Emerging Coastal Per-Capita Risk of Dengue in Bangladesh, 2021-2025: A Nationwide Spatiotemporal Ecological Analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue has shifted from Dhaka-centric to nationwide in Bangladesh. AIM: To quantify spatiotemporal patterns and identify high-risk clusters across all 64 districts from 2021 to 2025, and, extending previous reports with data from 2025, this study aims to observe an ongoing shift in per-capita risk hotspots. METHODS: Retrospective ecological study of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) aggregate yearly data on suspected and laboratory-confirmed dengue admissions (n = 637,626 cases). Incidence per 100,000 population was calculated using 2022 census projections with 1.12% annual growth. Global (Moran's I) and local (Getis-Ord Gi∗) spatial autocorrelation and prospective space-time scan statistics (SaTScan) were applied. RESULTS: National incidence: 76.4/100,000/year. 2025 rate-adjusted Moran's I = 0.328 (p = 0.001). Raw-case hotspots: Greater Dhaka; population-adjusted hotspots: Jhalokathi, Barguna (coastal). High-rate space-time cluster (2024-2025): Dhaka, Manikganj (RR = 3.13, p = 0.001). Dhaka O/E = 4.31 (RR = 6.38). Two low-rate clusters (north, southeast). CONCLUSION: Urban hyperendemicity, characterized by a high case volume, coupled with the emerging coastal per-capita risk, necessitates tailored interventions. Intensive vector control is essential in Dhaka, while early-warning surveillance should be implemented in coastal districts.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective ecological study was conducted using aggregate yearly data on suspected and laboratory-confirmed dengue admissions (n = 637,626 cases) from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) across all 64 districts in Bangladesh from 2021 to 2025.
analysis.methods: Incidence per 100,000 population was calculated using 2022 census projections with 1.12% annual growth. Global (Moran's I) and local (Getis-Ord Gi∗) spatial autocorrelation and prospective space-time scan statistics (SaTScan) were applied to analyze spatiotemporal patterns.
analysis.main_results: The national incidence rate was 76.4/100,000/year. In 2025, the rate-adjusted Moran's I was 0.328 (p = 0.001). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights urban hyperendemicity in Dhaka and the emerging coastal per-capita risk, indicating a shift in dengue transmission patterns that requires tailored interventions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the spatiotemporal patterns of dengue in Bangladesh from 2021 to 2025, revealing a shift from Dhaka-centric to nationwide transmission. The research highlights urban hyperendemicity and emerging coastal risk, emphasizing the need for targeted interventions. Using ecological data from the Directorate General of Health Services, the study calculates incidence rates and applies spatial autocorrelation and space-time scan statistics to identify high-risk clusters. Results show a national incidence rate of 76.4/100,000/year, with Dhaka and Manikganj identified as high-risk areas. The study underscores the importance of adapting vector control strategies and implementing early-warning systems in coastal regions. However, the reliance on aggregate data and potential spatial autocorrelation bias limits the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热已从达卡中心转移到孟加拉国全国范围。本研究旨在量化时空模式并识别 2021 年至 2025 年所有 64 个地区的高风险集群,利用 2025 年的数据扩展之前的报告,以观察人均风险热点的持续变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2021 年至 2025 年间孟加拉国所有 64 个地区卫生服务总局 (DGHS) 收集的疑似和实验室确诊登革热病例(n = 637,626 例)的年度汇总数据进行了一项回顾性生态研究。
elements_zh.methods: 发病率 每 100,000 人口的发病率采用 2022 年人口普查预测数据(年增长率为 1.12%)计算。研究应用了全局(Moran's I)和局部(Getis-Ord Gi∗)空间自相关分析以及前瞻性时空扫描统计(SaTScan)来分析时空模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 全国 发病率 率为 76.4/100,000/年。2025 年,利率调整后的 Moran's I 为 0.328 (p = 0.001)。在大达卡发现了原始病例热点,而经过人口调整的热点则在贾洛卡蒂和巴尔古纳(沿海)。在达卡和马尼克甘杰发现了一个高速率时空星团(2024-2025)(RR = 3.13,p = 0.001)。达卡的 O/E 比率为 4.31 (RR = 6.38)。在北部和东南部地区发现了两个低率集群。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了达卡的城市高流行和新兴的沿海人均风险,表明登革热 传播 模式发生了转变,需要量身定制的干预措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,达卡需要加强 媒介 控制,沿海地区需要 监测 预警,以应对不断变化的登革热风险形势。

papers.title: Editorial: Emerging arboviruses in the Americas: epidemiology, public health impact, and future preparedness
papers.abstract: The burden of arboviral diseases is intensifying rather than stabilizing. Dengue continues to reach unprecedented levels across the Americas, while geospatial clustering across Brazilian municipalities in 2024 highlights substantial fine-scale heterogeneity in transmission, underscoring the need for targeted and locally tailored control measures. This challenge is not confined to endemic regions: screening of blood donors in Shenzhen, China, illustrates how arboviruses can silently move through global travel networks and establish risks far beyond their traditional areas of circulation. Chikungunya provides a compelling example of the recurring epidemic waves that may characterize the coming decades. Twenty years after the devastating 2005-2006 epidemic, Réunion Island experienced another major outbreak in 2025. Our analysis estimated roughly 208 excess deaths among older adults during a three-month period; the age-specific excess mortality rate reached 145.3 per 100,000 (95% CI: 125.5-165.0) with a case fatality rate (CFR) of 2.4%, substantially exceeding officially reported fatalities (1). National-level analyses from Brazil similarly demonstrate a significant burden of hospitalization and mortality associated with chikungunya infection (2). Together, these findings suggest that the true impact of chikungunya has been consistently underestimated. The Réunion experience serves as a warning for the Americas, where more than a decade has passed since the virus became established following its introduction in 2014-2015. Conditions favorable for a comparable resurgence may already be in place. A recurring lesson emerges across arboviral diseases: surveillance systems based primarily on laboratory-confirmed cases frequently underestimate the true burden of infection and disease.Vectors remain central to this intensification. Several contributions in this Research Topic highlight the increasingly complex ecological and epidemiological factors shaping arboviral transmission. Studies range from the growing prevalence of pyrethroid resistance (kdr) mutations in Aedes aegypti populations in northeastern Argentina-threatening the long-term effectiveness of conventional vector control-to transcriptomic investigations of Wolbachia in this mosquito species, which reveal promising avenues for biological control interventions. Human factors also contribute substantially. A study assessing knowledge and attitudes toward chikungunya among healthcare workers in Chengdu, China, identified important awareness gaps that may delay recognition and diagnosis. Against this backdrop, climate variability-including the prospect of future El Niño events-is likely to amplify transmission risks and contribute to increasingly severe dengue seasons, alongside renewed activity of chikungunya, yellow fever, and Oropouche virus.The most concerning trend emerging from this collection is the continued geographic and ecological expansion of arboviruses. Yellow fever activity has intensified markedly, with 2025 recording the highest annual case count since 2020 and transmission extending into areas without a historical record of disease occurrence, including São Paulo State (3). Genomic investigation demonstrates the virus re-emerging across forest and periurban environments while advancing along forest edges toward densely populated, and often under-vaccinated, communities (4). Importantly, the prospect of yellow fever re-urbanization is no longer merely theoretical. Yellow fever virus has been detected and isolated from Aedes albopictus in an urban green area of São Paulo State (5). At the same time, Aedes vittatus-first recorded in the Americas in the Dominican Republic in 2019 (6) and now expanding across both insular and continental Caribbean regions-represents another potential bridge vector connecting sylvatic and urban transmission cycles (7). In this context, suboptimal vaccination coverage in newly affected areas remains the most important modifiable vulnerability.Oropouche virus presents a parallel narrative of geographic expansion. Once considered largely confined to the Amazon Basin, the virus has increasingly demonstrated its capacity to spread beyond its historical range. Surveillance efforts in wild birds at rehabilitation centers in Florida are now evaluating whether competent vertebrate hosts exist in North America, an increasingly relevant question given the growing number of imported human infections. Within Brazil, genomic surveillance recently documented the first imported case in Rio Grande do Sul, alongside enzootic circulation of Culicoides paraensis, signaling a tangible outbreak risk in one of the southernmost regions of the country (8). Additional studies further emphasize the importance of vigilance at the margins of known transmission zones. Chikungunya provides a compelling example of the recurring epidemic waves that may characterize the coming decades. Twenty years after the devastating 2005-2006 epidemic, Réunion Island experienced another major outbreak in 2025. Our analysis estimated roughly 208 excess deaths among older adults during a three-month period; the age-specific excess mortality rate reached 145.3 per 100,000 (95% CI: 125.5-165.0) with a case fatality rate (CFR) of 2.4%, substantially exceeding officially reported fatalities (1). National-level analyses from Brazil similarly demonstrate a significant burden of hospitalization and mortality associated with chikungunya infection (2). Together, these findings suggest that the true impact of chikungunya has been consistently underestimated. The Réunion experience serves as a warning for the Americas, where more than a decade has passed since the virus became established following its introduction in 2014-2015. Conditions favorable for a comparable resurgence may already be in place. A recurring lesson emerges across arboviral diseases: surveillance systems based primarily on laboratory-confirmed cases frequently underestimate the true burden of infection and disease.Vectors remain central to this intensification. Several contributions in this Research Topic highlight the increasingly complex ecological and epidemiological factors shaping arboviral transmission. Studies range from the growing prevalence of pyrethroid resistance (kdr) mutations in Aedes aegypti populations in northeastern Argentina-threatening the long-term effectiveness of conventional vector control-to transcriptomic investigations of Wolbachia in this mosquito species, which reveal promising avenues for biological control interventions. Human factors also contribute substantially. A study assessing knowledge and attitudes toward chikungunya among healthcare workers in Chengdu, China, identified important awareness gaps that may delay recognition and diagnosis. Against this backdrop, climate variability-including the prospect of future El Niño events-is likely to amplify transmission risks and contribute to increasingly severe dengue seasons, alongside renewed activity of chikungunya, yellow fever, and Oropouche virus.The most concerning trend emerging from this collection is the continued geographic and ecological expansion of arboviruses. Yellow fever activity has intensified markedly, with 2025 recording the highest annual case count since 2020 and transmission extending into areas without a historical record of disease occurrence, including São Paulo State (3). Genomic investigation demonstrates the virus re-emerging across forest and periurban environments while advancing along forest edges toward densely populated, and often under-vaccinated, communities (4). Importantly, the prospect of yellow fever re-urbanization is no longer merely theoretical. Yellow fever virus has been detected and isolated from Aedes albopictus in an urban green area of São Paulo State (5). At the same time, Aedes vittatus-first recorded in the Americas in the Dominican Republic in 2019 (6) and now expanding across both insular and continental Caribbean regions-represents another potential bridge vector connecting sylvatic and urban transmission cycles (7). Once considered largely confined to the Amazon Basin, the virus has increasingly demonstrated its capacity to spread beyond its historical range. Surveillance efforts in wild birds at rehabilitation centers in Florida are now evaluating whether competent vertebrate hosts exist in North America, an increasingly relevant question given the growing number of imported human infections. Within Brazil, genomic surveillance recently documented the first imported case in Rio Grande do Sul, alongside enzootic circulation of Culicoides paraensis, signaling a tangible outbreak risk in one of the southernmost regions of the country (8). Additional studies further emphasize the importance of vigilance at the margins of known transmission zones. The detection of alphavirus circulation in Costa Rica, together with the description of the first case of West Nile virus meningoencephalitis in southwest Michigan, illustrates how arboviruses continue to establish themselves in new ecological settings, host populations, and vulnerable patient groups. Clinical reports describing neurological manifestations-including Guillain-Barré syndrome accompanied by bilateral visual impairment associated with an emerging reassortant lineage in Ceará ( 9)-further expand the recognized disease phenotype. The possibility of congenital Oropouche syndrome has also gained increasing attention. A hypothesis initially raised within this Research Topic has since been reinforced by reports of newborns presenting with microcephaly following maternal infection in Brazil (10). These findings suggest that the public health implications of Oropouche virus may be substantially broader than previously appreciated. More broadly, mechanistic studies included in this collection contribute valuable insights into arboviral pathogenesis. For example, evidence demonstrating that disruption of a glycosylation site in the Zika virus envelope protein attenuates viral replication provides important clues regarding determinants of flaviviral virulence and identifies potential targets for future intervention strategies.Chikungunya reinforces this theme from a different perspective. Rather than revealing a new clinical syndrome, recent evidence highlights a long-recognized but consistently underreported outcome: mortality. Rather, they comprise a complex and evolving constellation of threats that require tailored responses. Recognizing the distinct epidemiological, ecological, and clinical dimensions of each risk is the first step toward building the preparedness that the region urgently needs.
